title: HGPS cross-dataset meta-analysis and IQM QAOA benchmark: analysis code
description: Analysis code, intermediate results and raw IQM Garnet measurement counts for the manuscript Cross-Dataset Transcriptomic Analysis of Shared HGPS Features and Exploratory Quantum Network Benchmarking (Jeong, Byun et al.). The workflow covers dataset-specific differential expression of GSE306264, GSE231761, GSE198983 and GSE165409, a gene-wise random-effects meta-analysis of the three human datasets with a donor-aware sensitivity analysis for GSE231761, Hallmark/GO enrichment, cross-species comparison with Lmna G609G mouse aorta, construction of STRING Max-Cut and co-expression Ising QUBO instances, exact and classical baselines, QAOA on IQM Garnet, and scoring against exact optima and equal-budget random sampling. See README.md.
